Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.math

Class CoordinatePlane

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.SceneObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.GroupObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.math.CoordinatePlane
public final class CoordinatePlane extends GroupObject
Cartesian coordinates in a bounded pixel rectangle; child plots share this transform.

Maps mathematical x/y coordinates to a bounded pixel rectangle, reversing y for screen space. Functions, areas and plot points must be direct children; other children retain ordinary pixel coordinates.

    • CoordinatePlane

      public CoordinatePlane(String id, double xmin, double xmax, double ymin, double ymax, boolean grid, double step)
      Creates a configured CoordinatePlane instance.
      Parameters:
      id - nonblank identity, unique within the containing scene
      xmin - finite lower mathematical x bound
      xmax - finite upper mathematical x bound
      ymin - finite lower mathematical y bound
      ymax - finite upper mathematical y bound
      grid - whether grid lines are enabled
      step - positive major tick spacing in mathematical units
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an input violates the constraints described above
